informal_statement: Area of a unit-chord circular segment.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At MorgansArcFunction.lean:92-93, the source contract is `noncomputable def area (θ : ℝ) : ℝ := (θ - sin θ * cos θ) / (4 * sin θ ^ 2)`. The unit-chord normalized area and arc length are constructed on 0 < theta < pi. The inverse is used geometrically only at positive area; its explicit totalization is not confused with an inverse outside that domain.
